articles.title: FedEx's planned spin-off of FedEx Freight advances, board named
articles.mainIdea: FedEx's planned spin-off of FedEx Freight advances, board named
articles.summary: The Commercial Appeal: FedEx's planned spin-off of FedEx Freight advances, board named. Memphis-based FedEx Corp. has filed the Form 10 registration statement with the SEC in the planned spin-off of FedEx Freight.

articles.title: FedEx Freight targets strategic density in spin-off
articles.mainIdea: FedEx Freight targets strategic density in spin-off
articles.summary: Trucking Dive: FedEx Freight targets strategic density in spin-off. “We believe door count — not terminal count — is the most relevant measure of our network capacity,” the business said in a key securities filing ahead of the June spinoff.

articles.title: FedEx Sets Financing, Board for FedEx Freight Spinoff
articles.mainIdea: FedEx Sets Financing, Board for FedEx Freight Spinoff
articles.summary: The Wall Street Journal: FedEx Sets Financing, Board for FedEx Freight Spinoff. FedEx Freight has entered into a five-year, $1.2 billion revolving-credit facility and a three-year, $600 million delayed-draw term-loan facility.
